title: Feature: windowed fullscreen RDP via Alt+click, preserving the host taskbar
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Feature

Add a windowed fullscreen mode for a single RDP session. The remote desktop fills a borderless host window maximized to the current monitor's working area, leaving the local taskbar accessible. No connection tree, menu, toolbar or tab strip should remain visible. With auto-hide disabled on both desktops, the remote taskbar sits immediately above the local taskbar.
